{
  "brief": {
    "topic": "LLM Inference Performance on Multi-GPU AMD Setup",
    "audience": "local LLM enthusiasts",
    "problem_or_goal": "Seeking recommendations for the most efficient VRAM backend and optimal configurations for maximizing output speed/throughput when running large language models on a multi-GPU AMD setup.",
    "context": "A user with a specific multi-GPU AMD hardware configuration (2x AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX + 1x Radeon RX 7800 XT, 64GB total VRAM) is looking for advice on optimizing LLM inference performance, particularly for Gemma3:27b and Qwen3 32B models.",

    "facts": [
      {
        "id": "F1",
        "text": "The user's hardware includes two AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX GPUs and one Radeon RX 7800 XT GPU, with a total effective VRAM of 64GB.",

      },
      {
        "id": "F4",
        "text": "Previous experiments with VLLM and llama.cpp on older models showed performance differences of only 1-2 tokens per second, which the user found inconclusive.",
        "evidence_quote": "I've previously experimented with these backends with older models, and observed performance differences of only around 1-2 tokens per second, which was inconclusive.",
        "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"
      },
      {
        "id": "F5",
        "text": "The user observed better speed with Vulkan and llama.cpp for Qwen3::30B MOE at 110 token/s and for Qwen3:235B\\_Q2\\_K from unsloth at around 14 token/s.",
        "evidence_quote": "I also got better speed with Vulkan and llama.cpp for Qwen3::30B MOE for 110 token/s and around 14 token/s for Qwen3:235B\\_Q2\\_K form unsloth.",
        "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"

        "status": "source-author report, not independently verified measurement"
      }
    ],
    "allowed_claims": [
      "Users with similar AMD multi-GPU setups may have relevant experience.",
      "Backend performance can vary for different models and configurations.",
      "Quantization methods and bit depths can impact LLM inference speed."
